def transform(grid):
    # Components with congruent shapes exchange colors: locate shape components,
    # then map 1-patterns to their matching colored reference component.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                x,y=stack.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(x+dx,y+dy)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            minr=min(x for x,y in cells); minc=min(y for x,y in cells)
            shape=frozenset((x-minr,y-minc) for x,y in cells)
            comps.append((color,cells,shape))
    groups={}
    for color,cells,shape in comps: groups.setdefault(shape,[]).append((color,cells))
    # For each shape appearing in two distinct colors, recolor first one to
    # the color of the other (the pairwise swap direction evident in demos).
    for shape,items in groups.items():
        if len(items)==2:
            (a,ca),(b,cb)=items
            for x,y in ca: out[x][y]=b
            for x,y in cb: out[x][y]=a
    return out
PY
